name: astryx
description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
one_liner: A free, ready-to-use set of polished website building-blocks (buttons, forms, menus) that Meta itself uses internally, so you don't have to design and code them from scratch.
buyer: A freelance web developer or small product studio building client websites and apps who wants a professional look without hiring a dedicated designer.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer uses it as the default UI kit for every new client project, cutting build time while charging the same project fee.
A startup studio offers 'MVP in two weeks' builds, using its components and themes to ship a polished-looking product fast.
A design agency builds a few custom themes on top of it and resells them as a premium theme pack to other developers.

money_ideas.idea: Sell custom themes or templates built on it to other developers
Faster, cheaper MVP-build service for startups using it as the base UI kit

steal_this: Build and list 2-3 polished themes (a 'fintech dark mode', a 'SaaS landing page') on a template marketplace this weekend.
